summary: Defines how a WebRTC data channel is used to carry CLUE protocol messages between two CLUE entities. This gives telepresence endpoints a reliable path for their control messages alongside the media. It is an experimental document.

eli5.summary: Besides sending pictures and sound, video rooms must pass little notes to each other. This document says how to use a built-in message lane in a WebRTC connection to carry those notes.

questions: can clue use a webrtc data channel
